    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    van_patches = image_patch.find("white van")
    shop_patches = image_patch.find("commercial shop")

        return image_patch
    
    near_shops = [v for v in van_patches if any(distance(v, s) < 100 for s in shop_patches)]
    
    return near_shops
